description:
About this space
Feel welcomed and relax in this beautiful garden apartment with a contemporary feel. Offering a perfect blend of modern comfort and style. Ideal for couples, friends and small families.

Situated just minutes away from the V&A Waterfront, Sea Point Promenade, and local cafes and restaurants, this apartment is perfect for exploring the vibrant lifestyle of Cape Town.

The apartment is safe and secure with a tag system to get in and out.

The space
This modern 2 bedroom apartment is sunny, spacious and offers ultimate convenience and comfort. Open plan lounge and dining area lead out onto a generous sized garden. Full HD TV and High speed fibre connection.

The kitchen is fully equipped with fridge, microwave, dishwasher, oven and hob. Nespresso coffee machine and pods.

The master bedroom has a queen sized bed, a lovely study desk and opens up to the garden and patio area with café style table and chairs. Second bedroom has two single beds with loads of cupboard space. Both bedrooms with ceiling fans.

The bathroom has a lovely sized shower and washing machine. Parking available in the automated garage and off street parking.

Guest access
Guest can have access to the apartment, garden and garage. Entrance to the apartment is gained through the main entrance or the top entrance of the building. Remote control gate access to the lock up garage.
The apartment is safe and secure with a tag system to get in and out.

Other things to note
There is a secure lock up garage that can be accessed. The garage will only suit sedan type vehicles as the roof is lower than a standard garage. Additional street parking available in front of the building.
The apartment is safe and secure and access tags and keys will be given to the guests. There is a self check-in facility available.
